examples: 我弟弟在小学上学。
Wǒ dìdi zài xiǎoxué shàngxué.
My younger brother goes to primary school.
我弟弟在这所小学上学。
Wǒ dìdi zài zhè suǒ xiǎoxué shàngxué.
My younger brother attends this primary school.
我姐姐在中学上学。
Wǒ jiějie zài zhōngxué shàngxué.
My older sister attends secondary school.
我姐姐在那所中学教中文。
Wǒ jiějie zài nà suǒ zhōngxué jiāo Zhōngwén.
My older sister teaches Chinese at that secondary school.
他在大学学习中文。
Tā zài dàxué xuéxí Zhōngwén.
He studies Chinese at university.
我哥哥明年要去北京的大学学习。
Wǒ gēge míngnián yào qù Běijīng de dàxué xuéxí.
My older brother will study at a university in Beijing next year.
我喜欢上学。
Wǒ xǐhuan shàngxué.
I like to go to school.
妹妹每天七点半出门去上学。
Mèimei měi tiān qī diǎn bàn chūmén qù shàngxué.
My younger sister leaves for school at seven thirty every day.
我喜欢读书。
Wǒ xǐhuan dúshū.
I like reading.
我喜欢在晚上安静地读书。
Wǒ xǐhuan zài wǎnshang ānjìng de dúshū.
I like reading quietly in the evening.
他是小学生。
Tā shì xiǎoxuéshēng.
He's a primary-school student.
那个小学生每天自己走路去学校。
Nàge xiǎoxuéshēng měi tiān zìjǐ zǒulù qù xuéxiào.
That primary-school student walks to school alone every day.
她是中学生。
Tā shì zhōngxuéshēng.
She's a secondary-school student.
很多中学生每天都坐公交车上学。
Hěn duō zhōngxuéshēng měi tiān dōu zuò gōngjiāochē shàngxué.
Many secondary-school students take the bus to school every day.
我是大学生。
Wǒ shì dàxuéshēng.
I'm a university student.
我的朋友是大学生，正在学中文。
Wǒ de péngyou shì dàxuéshēng, zhèngzài xué Zhōngwén.
My friend is a university student studying Chinese.
我们八点上课。
Wǒmen bā diǎn shàngkè.
Our class starts at eight.
我们八点上课，十点休息一下。
Wǒmen bā diǎn shàngkè, shí diǎn xiūxi yíxià.
Class starts at eight, and we take a short break at ten.
我们十点下课。
Wǒmen shí diǎn xiàkè.
Our class finishes at ten.
下课以后，我和同学一起去吃饭。
Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ hé tóngxué yìqǐ qù chīfàn.
After class, my classmates and I go eat together.
我有一个问题。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge wèntí.
I have a question.
我有一个问题想问老师。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge wèntí xiǎng wèn lǎoshī.
I have a question I want to ask the teacher.
我早上八点上班。
Wǒ zǎoshang bā diǎn shàngbān.
I start work at eight in the morning.
妈妈每天早上八点上班，下午五点下班。
Māma měi tiān zǎoshang bā diǎn shàngbān, xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn xiàbān.
Mom starts work at eight and finishes at five every day.
我下午五点下班。
Wǒ xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn xiàbān.
I finish work at five in the afternoon.
我今天六点下班，晚上和朋友吃饭。
Wǒ jīntiān liù diǎn xiàbān, wǎnshang hé péngyou chīfàn.
I finish work at six today and have dinner with friends.
他是医生。
Tā shì yīshēng.
He is doctor.
这位医生每天在医院工作到晚上。
Zhè wèi yīshēng měi tiān zài yīyuàn gōngzuò dào wǎnshang.
This doctor works at the hospital until evening every day.
我会做饭。
Wǒ huì zuòfàn.
I can cook.
我会做饭，但是今天想去饭店吃。
Wǒ huì zuòfàn, dànshì jīntiān xiǎng qù fàndiàn chī.
I can cook, but today I want to eat at a restaurant.
这是我的电话。
Zhè shì wǒ de diànhuà.
This is my phone.
你的电话号码是多少？
Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
What is your phone number?
我喜欢打电话。
Wǒ xǐhuan dǎ diànhuà.
I like to call by phone.
我晚上给妈妈打电话，问她怎么样。
Wǒ wǎnshang gěi māma dǎ diànhuà, wèn tā zěnmeyàng.
I'll call Mom tonight and ask how she's doing.
喂，你好！
Wèi, nǐ hǎo!
Hello, speaking!
喂，您好！请问李先生在吗？
Wèi, nín hǎo! Qǐngwèn Lǐ xiānsheng zài ma?
Hello! May I speak to Mr. Li?
我喜欢说话。
Wǒ xǐhuan shuōhuà.
I like to talk.
老师说话很慢，所以我能听懂。
Lǎoshī shuōhuà hěn màn, suǒyǐ wǒ néng tīng dǒng.
The teacher speaks slowly, so I can understand.
我晚上看电视。
Wǒ wǎnshang kàn diànshì.
I watch TV in the evening.
我每天晚上和家人一起看电视。
Wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang hé jiārén yìqǐ kàn diànshì.
I watch television with my family every evening.
